# AryansArcade

> AryansArcade is the studio of Aryan Singh, who builds Android and iOS apps, fast websites and AI automations for people and small businesses. Contact: hello@aryansarcade.in.

## Projects
- [Spinpath](https://greedilearner.github.io/spinpath/): Spin a topic, learn it, say it out loud. A learning website that spins a random concept from your chosen path (AI engineer, web, data, security and more), then turns it into speaking drills: debate motions, fresh articles from the past week, interview questions and "explain it to…" prompts. Built with JavaScript, HTML / CSS, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages. Status: Live, 2026.
- [Excuses](https://aryansarcade.in/#/work): A to-do app that asks why, kindly. Schedule tasks, then record a voice diary when they slip. AI reads the patterns behind missed tasks and reflects them back without shame. Built first in Expo / React Native, then ported to Kotlin Multiplatform with shared UI for Android and iOS. Built with React Native, Expo, Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose, Ktor. Status: Android & iOS, 2026.
- [Carousel Studio](https://github.com/greedilearner/post_automation): Thoughts in, Instagram carousels out. An Android app that turns spoken reflections, notes or YouTube transcripts into Instagram-ready carousel images and X threads. Runs on a local Ollama model, remembers your voice and past posts, and saves straight to the gallery. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, Ollama, RAG. Status: Android, 2026.
- [Nightly AI Podcast](https://aryansarcade.in/#/work): Ask a question at night, hear the answer by morning. An automation that asks for tonight's learning topic, drives Google NotebookLM in a real browser to generate a two-host audio overview, downloads the MP3 and files it in a personal podcast library with its own web player. Built with Python, Playwright, Flask, Scheduler, SQLite. Status: Running nightly, 2026.

## Services
- Automation: The boring, repeated work, done by software instead of people. Scheduled jobs, browser automation and AI workflows that pull data, fill forms, post content, generate reports and send them where they need to go. Like the nightly podcast generator, but for your business. Typical timeline: 1–3 weeks.
- Website Development: Fast, good-looking websites that are easy to keep up to date. Portfolios, business sites, landing pages and web apps. Designed with care, built to load fast on phones, and set up so you can edit content yourself. Typical timeline: 2–4 weeks.
- App Development: Mobile apps people keep on their home screen. Native Android in Kotlin, or one codebase for Android and iOS with React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform. From first prototype to a build you can put in the Play Store. Typical timeline: 3–8 weeks.
- AI Features: Put Claude, GPT, Gemini or a local model inside your product. Chat, search over your own documents, voice notes to text, summaries and smart suggestions, built into the app or site you already have. Typical timeline: 1–4 weeks.

## How to hire
- Email hello@aryansarcade.in with what you need, who it is for and your timeline. Work runs Call → Plan → Build → Launch, with weekly updates and full code ownership at the end.
